note: IMD Kolkata issues a thunderstorm warning with squall for the Asansol sub-division, gusts of 70 to 90 km/h expected from 18:00.
Squall line reaches Neamatpur. Gust of 96 km/h recorded at the Sitarampur monitoring mast, with heavy rain and hail at Mohishila.
Rainfall of 88 mm recorded in five hours at the Neamatpur substation gauge.
A second line of thunderstorms passes over Kulti with gusts to 62 km/h. No further squall recorded.
Rain stops. Winds fall below 20 km/h across the substation area.
